scope: Limited focal supplement, not a systematic three-database novelty review or external human verification
backbone_preserved: CNN causal -> LSTM unidirectional -> temporal content attention (M00)

sources.title: Algorithms for Computing the Sample Variance: Analysis and Recommendations
sources.reading_location: p.242, equations 1.3a–b; original scan and visual equation check in preceding theory review
sources.established_mechanism: Incremental update of mean and corrected sum of squares.
sources.relation_to_current_design: The six-known plus one-new return decomposition and coefficient 6/49 specialize this standard identity.
sources.not_established: It supplies no predictor of the next return and does not establish novelty of a neural architecture.

sources.title: Sample-Specific Output Constraints for Neural Networks
sources.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence 35(8), 6812–6819
sources.reading_location: pp.6814–6816, equations 3–5; Supported Constraints and Generalizations, scalar-threshold bullet on p.6816
sources.established_mechanism: Sample-specific output domains and the explicit scalar guard phi(z,s)=exp(z)+b, s=b.
sources.relation_to_current_design: A known lower bound plus a positive output is prior art; replacing exp with softplus alone is not a substantive novelty claim.
sources.not_established: The paper neither defines A from six financial returns nor evaluates this BTC sigma7 task.
sources.metadata_note: Use authors from the published AAAI PDF. No new independent DOI-resolver verification is claimed.

sources.title: The Folded t Distribution
sources.reading_location: Journal pp.2718–2720, PDF pages 3–5; absolute-value definition, reflected densities, section 2 equation 2.1
sources.reading_scope_change: The V2 design record previously verified metadata/cover only. This closure adds a delegated visual reading of these original pages, not a full-article reading.
sources.established_mechanism: Folding a Student-t distribution by absolute value; density sums the positive and reflected branches.
sources.relation_to_current_design: A half-t magnitude with zero location is a special folded-t case; the family and factor two are not new.
sources.not_established: No conditional sigma7 predictor or novelty of our exact A-conditioned transport is established.
sources.metadata_note: Publication year is 1990; the MPRA deposit date in 2007 is not the publication date.

sources.title: DeepAR: Probabilistic Forecasting with Autoregressive Recurrent Networks
sources.reading_location: Version 3, section 3.1, Gaussian and negative-binomial likelihood parameterizations; section 3.2 equation 2
sources.established_mechanism: A recurrent network produces conditional distribution parameters; affine output plus softplus ensures positive scale.
sources.relation_to_current_design: The network-to-positive-scale pattern is established; our backbone remains CNN–LSTM–attention.
sources.not_established: The read version experiments with Gaussian and negative-binomial distributions, not our half-t sigma7 head.
sources.metadata_note: Metadata corresponds to the three-author 2019 arXiv version; it is not silently merged with later journal metadata.

sources.title: GARCHNet: Value-at-Risk Forecasting with GARCH Models Based on Neural Networks
sources.established_mechanism: Neural conditional variance and likelihood parameters, softplus positivity and Student-t innovations.
sources.relation_to_current_design: Positive financial density heads are established; this source is not a sigma7 or folded-magnitude decoder.
sources.not_established: Its variance-standardized Student-t parameterization cannot be copied as an ordinary location-scale t scale without conversion.

sources.title: From GARCH to Neural Network for Volatility Forecast
sources.reading_location: Methodology, Equivalent Loss Function equations 4–6 and GARCH-LSTM equation 7
sources.established_mechanism: GARCH-derived neural components, conditional Student-t likelihood and coupling to LSTM.
sources.relation_to_current_design: Student-t financial likelihood and GARCH–neural combination are prior mechanisms.
sources.not_established: Its conditional variance/proxy, long history and parameterization differ from centered sigma7, U and the fixed D7 contract.
sources.metadata_note: AAAI DOI is carried from the previous source record; the new focal read is the original arXiv body.

sources.title: SurVAE Flows: Surjections to Bridge the Gap between VAEs and Flows
sources.reading_location: Section 2 equation 1; section 3.1 table 2; arXiv appendix D equations 13–22
sources.established_mechanism: Change of variables and absolute-value surjections with sign branches.
sources.relation_to_current_design: Mathematical antecedent for magnitude and density transport only; no flow replaces the CNN–LSTM–attention backbone.
sources.not_established: It does not prescribe our sigma7 decoder, nu=5, lambda=0.1 or positive N128 quadrature.

sources.title: Residual Deep Learning for Realized Volatility Using a Hybrid HAR-LSTM Model with ARIMA Features and SHAP Interpretability
sources.reading_location: Sections 3.1 and 4.3 in preceding focal review
sources.established_mechanism: Rolling volatility with a known contribution, a horizon-consistent GARCH diagnostic and non-overlapping target comparison.
sources.relation_to_current_design: Known-history plus future-innovation reasoning has financial forecasting precedents.
sources.not_established: The source uses a five-return uncentered squared-return target, not our seven-return centered population deviation.

sources.title: ARCH–LSTM Structural Equivalence with Hybrid Student-t Likelihood Loss for Financial Volatility Forecasting
sources.venue: Journal of Risk and Financial Management 19(9), 688
sources.reading_location: Section 2.3, equations 6–8; section 3.1 target definition; section 4.6.2 contextual limitation
sources.established_mechanism: LSTM output with softplus and a hybrid squared-error plus Student-t negative-log-likelihood criterion.
sources.exact_similarity: A positive recurrent financial output and mixing a point loss with a heavy-tail likelihood are already documented.
sources.exact_difference: Its SSE compares predicted conditional variance with a centered return squared, and its likelihood is on the centered return. Our MSE is on sigma7 and our auxiliary likelihood is on U=|r_next-mean6|; the source does not give our floor, half-t transport or N128 integration.
sources.not_established: This source does not establish the exact V2 combination as prior identical architecture, nor validate our choice nu=5/lambda=0.1. Its equivalence proofs and reported empirical claims were not independently verified or reproduced.
